confidence_definition: Calibrated predicted probability assigned to the predicted class P(y = y_pred | x).

sms.selection_rationale: Sigmoid (Platt scaling) selected: Logistic Regression with balanced weighting shifts intercept towards the minority class. Platt scaling provides a smooth, monotonic sigmoid correction that dramatically reduces Log Loss from 0.0717 to 0.0401 and Brier Score from 0.0157 to 0.0116 without piecewise step artifacts from Isotonic regression.

email.selection_rationale: Sigmoid (Platt scaling) selected: Email dataset is well-balanced (47.9% legit / 52.1% phish) with large sample size (12,283 validation emails). Platt scaling achieves near-perfect calibration with Brier score 0.0084, Log Loss 0.0305, and ECE 0.0042 while guaranteeing strict monotonicity.

url.selection_rationale: Sigmoid (Platt scaling) selected: Tree ensembles like LightGBM produce sigmoid-distorted margins. Sigmoid calibration strictly preserves probability ranking and strict monotonicity, enabling an exact, continuous mapping of the 0.25 operational decision threshold into calibrated probability space (0.2526) with 100.00% decision equivalence. Brier score improves from 0.0734 to 0.0712 and ECE drops from 0.0215 to 0.0093.

threshold_interaction_analysis.explanation: Calibration shifts raw LightGBM probability estimates to reflect true empirical likelihood. A raw model output score of 0.25 corresponds empirically to a 25.3% true probability of being a malicious URL. The classification decision boundary remains identical to the Phase 4B optimized operating point.
